claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Amlexanox at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its known pharmacology (TBK1/IKKε inhibition, PDE inhibition, histamine modulation, nonsense-mutation readthrough) does not produce direct cell killing at achievable concentrations.
